userBrowserVisibility: The actual user browser was not accessible. No claim is made about its exact URL, stored Hub or worker. The reported failure was reproduced independently with real old and new production builds.
confirmedDefects: A waiting PWA update had no visible banner on Evolved login/onboarding without a project.
The old active worker continued serving the old precached root document on ordinary reload.
The installed plugin prompt helper also reloaded other old tabs on controlling, destroying an unsaved in-memory synthetic draft.
Filesystem delivery lacked the explicit mutable-entrypoint HTTP cache policy present for embedded sw.js.
Global App event handlers still blocked browser zoom despite the earlier design statement.
disprovedHypotheses: The root route already selects /evolved for Evolved context; no routing change was necessary.
corrections: One update banner above the auth boundary, preserving authenticated status/voice offsets.
Direct Workbox registration without a controlling-to-reload subscription; only the explicit initiating tab registers a reload listener.
Automatic plugin registration injection disabled; production output has exactly one registration.
HTML, worker and manifest HTTP cache headers unified for embedded and filesystem delivery; private API headers untouched.
Global browser zoom blockers removed; local component-specific gestures untouched.
immediateRecovery: Navigate directly to /evolved on the same Hub in a separate tab. This path is not precached and does not require worker activation, unregistering, cache deletion or changed Hub selection.
